points.title: Build system and reproducibility

points.title: CLI and error handling

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: METIS partitioning, owned/ghost exchange and reductions are implemented; delivered rank-study packages provide direct steady evidence.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual

naca0012_m015_inviscid.notes: Final Cd0.065395, Cl0.000481; last five 1000-row mean Cd0.06747,0.06540,0.06531,0.06540,0.06528. The visibly settled positive drag is extremely high for this symmetric low-Mach inviscid case, consistent with the report’s disclosed Rusanov dissipation limitation. Score5→2.5 for accuracy, without inferring false success from drag magnitude alone.

naca0012_m080_inviscid.notes: Final Cd0.050896, Cl−0.001511; last5000 force rows have Cd means 0.05100,0.05088,0.05089,0.05089,0.05090. Report discloses limiter/shock residual limit cycle and high low-Mach dissipation. Score5→3.5 for residual/accuracy confidence; no DQ inferred solely from the plateau.

naca0012_m200_inviscid.notes: Final Cd0.093723, Cl−0.000996, residual target reached at2800. Force plot exposes transient approach; plausible wave drag but no independent order or exact historic binary attribution. Score5→4.

naca0012_m015_laminar_re5000.notes: Final Cd0.488735 is almost an order of magnitude above a typical low-Re airfoil value; report/limitations_body.tex:3–17 itself labels viscous-dominated drag qualitative because of Rusanov dissipation. Last100 Cd0.488734998→0.488735051 is stable; this is an accuracy finding, not proof of false convergence. Delivered immutable dd0fabf force PNG SHA256 9ddbfcfd0dab544da8b89e09b74903090c71390d88bfcc7cbfab7efbdffa2405 uses a shared scale with startup Cd>300, flattening both late forces; score5→1.5 for quality and evidence floor.

naca0012_m080_laminar_re5000.notes: Final Cd0.154603 and last100 0.154384→0.154603, while final five 1000-row mean Cd0.14780,0.14307,0.14611,0.15021,0.15339 limit plateau confidence. Original delivered dd0fabf force PNG SHA256 b7cf840cfe778cd98cd3e3b9c8fe0fe774743bc2ec792837ebb475d52263e8e5 uses a shared axis with startup Cd>300, flattening both late force traces; score5→2 under the independent visual floor. No additional DQ from this plot alone.

naca0012_m200_laminar_re5000.notes: Immutable 4698ba1 report/results_body.tex:80–90 gives final Cd0.5699 and reports convergence at1000 steps. Submitted metadata SHA256 46ca7bfc0c841560b787e29dfdbaf5143905e43deb041159407c46cae516d68e says completed/converged, but force CSV SHA256 d88744c1fe8d5fed2dc4d294a371b58c6c5995a01cc77a466ed59cd488ad419e shows Cd0.673434→0.569866 final100, 0.618365→0.569866 final50 and 0.588552→0.569866 final20. TASK.md:140,172 requires clear early laminar convergence and stable forces; actual 3.036-order residual reduction is not disputed. DQ7; old score5→1. Other evidence and rubric review pending.

cylinder_m010_laminar_re20.notes: Final Cd6.027568, Cl−0.000770, last100 Cd6.027556→6.027568. Immutable report/results_body.tex:93–95 and limitations_body.tex:10–17 explicitly compare Cd≈6 to literature ≈2 and disclose low-Mach dissipation; stable force does not rescue the large physical error. The original force chart exposes overall Cd history despite a startup spike. Score5→2 for physical accuracy, not for unproven nonconvergence.

cylinder_m010_laminar_re200.notes: Contestant final response explicitly delivers 66-figure manifest. Immutable contestant final dd0fabfcc023518344f059416ab2d778a5f730af includes figure_manifest.csv SHA256 bc05797da6717343052ed4709630d9c5afeb00a6d6d1367d607a8f79a184a500 and Re200 force/residual PNGs SHA256 7b0360860baa908f3224b4d4a5672ac4f6b092d99c4762bdc81ad2f789b0e672 / 099200a9f1de5e1666813d32bb768709f195014d6cbf3743bf0bfc6ad4f16b65; force PNG visibly resolves late lift and drag. Curated tip omits those images but report/results_body.tex:115–118 gives Cd1.218, lift −0.456..0.482 and St0.173, with wake contour. Workspace force CSV SHA256 ba0fde273956c65831770077a10a200020bab3756d712e13278c97a0413d069f t>=750 gives Cd1.218117, lift −0.456063..0.481777, 26 upcrossings St0.173004. Actual delivered segment time600.01–900 after restart from _re200_roe_prod, whereas report describes restart from steady Rusanov state; provenance of predecessor/actual executable needs further review. Solver source freezes limiter after first inner iteration; recorded target fraction refers to frozen-limiter residual, and full refreshed-limiter target miss count is unproven. Previous note falsely asserted no force/residual; score2→4. No unsteady run.
